ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white/cream to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous high-intensity blobs located in the medial portions of both lobes. The left blob features internal low-intensity mottling and punctate spots. Both blobs are bounded by a low-intensity black margin along the trailing edge and center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A distinct V-shaped depression with an estimated pixel angle of 75 degrees and a vertical depth of approximately 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning into high-amplitude irregular jaggedness at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the leading edges of both lobes, tapering into a moderate concavity as the boundary approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel aggregates (yellowish-brown and white) concentrated exclusively at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological encrustations at the tips of both lobes creating irregular, non-linear edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown pigmentation overlaying the high-intensity white regions near the distal margins.
